topology_dependency: NONE in construction; premise law is topology-agnostic and may not name T1-T4 objects/scenarios.
positive_law: The entire image is one unbroken shallow relief skin. People, environment and relationships are formed only by continuous rises, falls, folds of height and broad curvature in that single surface; they are not assembled from separate plates, channels, modules or collage pieces. Human specificity comes from stable body-volume profile, relief depth rhythm and posture-scale curvature. Present consequence/history appears as a persistent local deformation whose surrounding relief continuity makes the changed state legible.

axes.representation ontology: one continuous shallow relief surface with all forms expressed as height variation
axes.spatial/relational visual organization: depth terraces, broad curvature, overlap and relief occlusion organize relation without separate objects as graphic layers
axes.figure-ground/material-edge grammar: continuous raised/recessed transitions and undercut-like relief edges; no notches/channels as identity devices and no detached plates
axes.human identity/specificity mechanism: distinct body-volume relief profile, depth cadence and posture-scale curvature per person
axes.consequence/history representation: persistent deformation of one continuous skin with surrounding continuity carrying changed-state evidence
axes.tonal/texture/atmosphere construction: near-neutral raking-light relief tone from height and curvature, with restrained surface grain

anti_motif: Do not make the image a conventional 3D scene merely coated in sculptural texture; the single relief skin must be the whole representational ontology.
construction_exclusions: no topology-specific object, pose, architecture or scenario
